title: Task starfleet/doku-update abgeschlossen
subtitle: User-Dokumentation konsolidiert
body:
USER.md documentation consolidated and deployed:

- All content translated to English (removed German headings from web frontend)
- Integrated Web UI documentation from doc/web-ui.md: tabs (Flotte, Tasks, Bus, Funk, Log, Sitzungen, Timer, Berichte, Files), API endpoints, model registry (gen-models-yaml), server management
- Integrated Reports documentation from doc/reports.md: CLI usage, web UI, storage, API
- Updated Appendix: File Layout to match current .starfleet-ai/var structure (dashboard/topics/, sop.d/, agent-claims/, log/, ships/, etc.)
- Removed architecture/implementation details (belong in architecture.md)
- Updated Further Reading links with all doc/ files
- Tests pass, make all + starfleet-bootstrap + web/timer restart verified
